Add Theme switch to this project exactly as specified here.

1. **Setup first.** Look for `ui/styles/kit.css` in the folder the `@/` import alias points to (`src/` in most Next.js apps, otherwise the project root). If it is missing, apply the one-time setup first: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/setup.md
2. **Components it uses.** None: Theme switch only needs the files below.
3. **Create the files.** Create every file under [Files](#files) at its exact path, with exactly the contents shown. If you can run shell commands, the download script below does this in one go.
4. **Register the CSS.** In `ui/styles/kit.css`, add this line directly above the `@source` line, skipping any already there:

   ```css
   @import "./components/theme-switch.css";
   ```

5. **Use it.** `import { ThemeSwitch } from '@/ui/components/theme-switch';` See [Usage](#usage). Tell the user which files you created.

**Rules.** Copy every file verbatim: do not restyle, rename classes, reformat, "improve", convert to another styling approach (CSS modules, styled-components, inline styles) or add npm packages. React and Tailwind CSS v4 only. Keep `'use client'` lines where they are. If a file already exists with identical contents, leave it. Fetch this doc and the source files as raw text (for example with `curl`), not through a summarising web reader: the code must arrive character for character.

## Specification

### Component: ThemeSwitch

A light / dark / system control: three icons in a pill-shaped segmented group with one gliding highlight. Uses `useTheme()`. Optionally reveals the new theme as a circle growing from the clicked option (View Transitions API).

#### Anatomy
```
<div class="ui-theme-switch [ui-theme-switch-sm]" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Theme" data-ready data-animate>
  <span class="ui-theme-switch-pill" aria-hidden></span>
  <button class="ui-theme-switch-item" role="radio" aria-checked aria-label="Light"  title="Light"  tabindex>sun</button>
  <button class="ui-theme-switch-item" role="radio" aria-checked aria-label="Dark"   title="Dark"   tabindex>moon</button>
  <button class="ui-theme-switch-item" role="radio" aria-checked aria-label="System" title="System" tabindex>monitor</button>
</div>
```

#### Props
- `reveal` — circular reveal, default **true**; instant swap where unsupported or under reduced motion.
- `size` — `md` (28px options, default) or `sm` (24px). On coarse pointers options are 36px.
- `label` — group name, default "Theme". Plus `HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>` and ref.
- Reads `mode` and calls `setMode` from `useTheme()`; options in order Light, Dark, System.

#### Visual rules
- Group: `inline-flex`, padding 2px, gap 2px, 1px `--ui-border`, fully rounded, `--ui-surface-muted`.
- Pill: `--ui-background` with `--ui-shadow-sm` (dark: `color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 14%, var(--ui-surface-muted))`, no shadow). Selected icon `--ui-foreground`, others `--ui-muted-foreground`. Icons 16px (14px at `sm`).
- Before the pill is measured (SSR) the selected option carries the highlight itself.

#### Behaviour
- Radio group with a roving tabindex (selected option = the one tab stop). Arrow keys / Home / End select (selection follows focus); click selects.
- Selecting the current mode does nothing.
- **Reveal**: if `reveal`, `document.startViewTransition` exists and reduced motion is off: set `<html data-ui-reveal>`, start the transition with `setMode(next)` as the update, then on `ready` animate `html` with `{ clipPath: [circle(0px at x y), circle(R at x y)] }, { duration: 520, easing: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), pseudoElement: '::view-transition-new(root)' }`. `R` = distance from (x, y) to the farthest viewport corner. (x, y) = pointer position, or the option's centre for keyboard activation. Remove `data-ui-reveal` when the transition finishes.
- CSS while `data-ui-reveal`: `::view-transition-old(root)` and `::view-transition-new(root)` have `animation: none; mix-blend-mode: normal`; old z-index 1, new z-index 2.

#### Motion
- Pill: `useIndicator` writes `--ui-tab-x/y/w/h` on the group; the pill moves with `transform` + width/height on `--ui-spring-morph` (550ms). `data-ready` after the first measurement, `data-animate` two frames later so the first placement is not animated.
- Item press `scale(.92)` on `--ui-spring-snappy`; colour 150ms.
- **Reduced motion**: no view transition (instant swap), pill jumps, no press scale.

#### Accessibility
- WAI-ARIA radio group: `role="radiogroup"`, `role="radio"`, `aria-checked`, roving tabindex. Icon-only options have `aria-label` and `title`. Focus ring `0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent)`.

#### Acceptance checks
- Clicking Dark adds `dark` to `<html>` and `aria-checked="true"` moves; the pill's x offset changes.
- Arrow keys move the selection; only the selected option has `tabindex="0"`.
- With reduced motion no `data-ui-reveal` attribute is ever set.
- Works with every `data-accent`, light and dark.

### `ui/components/theme-switch/theme-switch.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, useRef, type HTMLAttributes, type KeyboardEvent, type MouseEvent } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { prefersReducedMotion } from '../../lib/dom';
import { useIndicator } from '../../hooks/use-indicator';
import { Icon, type IconName } from '../../icons/icon';
import { useTheme, type ThemeMode } from '../../theme/use-theme';

export type ThemeSwitchSize = 'sm' | 'md';

export interface ThemeSwitchProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'onChange'> {
  /**
   * Reveal the new theme as a circle growing from the clicked option, using the
   * View Transitions API. Falls back to an instant swap where it is unsupported
   * and under `prefers-reduced-motion`. Default true.
   */
  reveal?: boolean;
  /** 28px (`md`, default) or 24px options. Touch screens always get 36px. */
  size?: ThemeSwitchSize;
  /** Accessible name of the group. Default "Theme". */
  label?: string;
}

const OPTIONS: { value: ThemeMode; label: string; icon: IconName }[] = [
  { value: 'light', label: 'Light', icon: 'sun' },
  { value: 'dark', label: 'Dark', icon: 'moon' },
  { value: 'system', label: 'System', icon: 'monitor' },
];

interface ViewTransitionLike {
  ready: Promise<unknown>;
  finished: Promise<unknown>;
}
type DocumentWithTransitions = { startViewTransition?: (update: () => void) => ViewTransitionLike };

const REVEAL_MS = 520;
const REVEAL_EASING = 'cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)';

/**
 * ThemeSwitch — light / dark / system as three icons with a gliding pill.
 * Reads and writes the theme through useTheme(). Choosing a theme can reveal
 * it as a circle that grows from the clicked option (View Transitions API).
 */
export const ThemeSwitch = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ThemeSwitchProps>(function ThemeSwitch(
  { reveal = true, size = 'md', label = 'Theme', className, onKeyDown, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const { mode, setMode } = useTheme();
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const composedRef = useComposedRefs(ref, listRef);
  const itemRefs = useRef<(HTMLButtonElement | null)[]>([]);

  useIndicator(listRef, '[role="radio"][aria-checked="true"]', mode);

  const choose = (next: ThemeMode, origin: { x: number; y: number }) => {
    if (next === mode) return;
    const doc = document as unknown as DocumentWithTransitions;
    if (!reveal || typeof doc.startViewTransition !== 'function' || prefersReducedMotion()) {
      setMode(next);
      return;
    }
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const radius = Math.hypot(
      Math.max(origin.x, window.innerWidth - origin.x),
      Math.max(origin.y, window.innerHeight - origin.y),
    );
    root.setAttribute('data-ui-reveal', '');
    const transition = doc.startViewTransition(() => setMode(next));
    transition.ready
      .then(() => {
        root.animate(
          { clipPath: [`circle(0px at ${origin.x}px ${origin.y}px)`, `circle(${radius}px at ${origin.x}px ${origin.y}px)`] },
          {
            duration: REVEAL_MS,
            easing: REVEAL_EASING,
            pseudoElement: '::view-transition-new(root)',
          } as KeyframeAnimationOptions,
        );
      })
      .catch(() => undefined);
    transition.finished.then(
      () => root.removeAttribute('data-ui-reveal'),
      () => root.removeAttribute('data-ui-reveal'),
    );
  };

  const centerOf = (el: HTMLElement) => {
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    return { x: r.left + r.width / 2, y: r.top + r.height / 2 };
  };

  const handleClick = (value: ThemeMode, e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    // Keyboard activation reports 0,0 — reveal from the button instead
    const origin = e.detail === 0 ? centerOf(e.currentTarget) : { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
    choose(value, origin);
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    onKeyDown?.(e);
    if (e.defaultPrevented) return;
    const current = OPTIONS.findIndex((o) => o.value === mode);
    let next = -1;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') next = (current + 1) % OPTIONS.length;
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') next = (current - 1 + OPTIONS.length) % OPTIONS.length;
    else if (e.key === 'Home') next = 0;
    else if (e.key === 'End') next = OPTIONS.length - 1;
    if (next < 0) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const el = itemRefs.current[next];
    if (!el) return;
    el.focus();
    choose(OPTIONS[next]!.value, centerOf(el));
  };

  return (
    <div
      role="radiogroup"
      aria-label={label}
      {...props}
      ref={composedRef}
      className={cn('ui-theme-switch', size === 'sm' && 'ui-theme-switch-sm', className)}
      onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
    >
      <span className="ui-theme-switch-pill" aria-hidden="true" />
      {OPTIONS.map((option, i) => {
        const checked = option.value === mode;
        return (
          <button
            key={option.value}
            ref={(el) => {
              itemRefs.current[i] = el;
            }}
            type="button"
            role="radio"
            aria-checked={checked}
            aria-label={option.label}
            title={option.label}
            tabIndex={checked ? 0 : -1}
            className="ui-theme-switch-item"
            onClick={(e) => handleClick(option.value, e)}
          >
            <Icon name={option.icon} size={size === 'sm' ? 14 : 16} />
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-indicator.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, type RefObject } from 'react';
import { prefersReducedMotion } from '../lib/dom';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from './use-isomorphic-layout-effect';

/**
 * A single highlight element that glides between the items of a container.
 * Measures the active item and writes `--ui-tab-x/y/w/h` on the container; CSS
 * moves one indicator with a transition. The container gets `data-ready`
 * after the first measurement (so SSR markup never jumps) and `data-animate`
 * two frames later (so the first placement is never animated).
 * The active item is scrolled into view horizontally when the container scrolls.
 *
 * @param containerRef positioned (position: relative) container that holds the items and the indicator
 * @param selector     selects the active item inside the container
 * @param key          changes whenever the active item changes
 */
export function useIndicator(containerRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, selector: string, key: unknown) {
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    const container = containerRef.current;
    if (!container) return;
    const measure = () => {
      const active = container.querySelector<HTMLElement>(selector);
      if (!active) {
        container.removeAttribute('data-ready');
        return;
      }
      const style = container.style;
      style.setProperty('--ui-tab-x', `${active.offsetLeft}px`);
      style.setProperty('--ui-tab-y', `${active.offsetTop}px`);
      style.setProperty('--ui-tab-w', `${active.offsetWidth}px`);
      style.setProperty('--ui-tab-h', `${active.offsetHeight}px`);
      container.setAttribute('data-ready', '');
    };
    measure();
    // Bring the active item into view when the list scrolls
    const active = container.querySelector<HTMLElement>(selector);
    if (active && container.scrollWidth > container.clientWidth) {
      const left = active.offsetLeft - 8;
      const right = active.offsetLeft + active.offsetWidth + 8;
      if (left < container.scrollLeft || right > container.scrollLeft + container.clientWidth) {
        const target = left < container.scrollLeft ? left : right - container.clientWidth;
        container.scrollTo({ left: target, behavior: prefersReducedMotion() ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
      }
    }
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(measure);
    ro.observe(container);
    for (const child of Array.from(container.children)) ro.observe(child);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, [containerRef, selector, key]);

  // Turn the transition on only after the first placement has painted
  useEffect(() => {
    const container = containerRef.current;
    if (!container) return;
    let raf2 = 0;
    const raf1 = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      raf2 = requestAnimationFrame(() => container.setAttribute('data-animate', ''));
    });
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf1);
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf2);
    };
  }, [containerRef]);
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect } from 'react';

/** useLayoutEffect in the browser, useEffect on the server (no SSR warning). */
export const useIsomorphicLayoutEffect = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? useLayoutEffect : useEffect;
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/lib/dom.ts`

```ts
/** True when rendering on the server (no DOM). */
export const isServer = typeof window === 'undefined';

/** Resolve once every animation on `el` (and its subtree) has finished. */
export function animationsFinished(el: Element | null, subtree = true): Promise<void> {
  if (!el || typeof el.getAnimations !== 'function') return Promise.resolve();
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    // Wait a frame so animations triggered by the state change have started.
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const anims = el.getAnimations({ subtree });
      if (!anims.length) return resolve();
      Promise.allSettled(anims.map((a) => a.finished)).then(() => resolve());
    });
  });
}

export function prefersReducedMotion(): boolean {
  return !isServer && window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches === true;
}
```

### `ui/theme/theme-script.tsx`

```tsx
/**
 * <ThemeScript /> — put it in <head> (Next.js: app/layout.tsx). It applies the
 * saved mode, accent and theme pack before the first paint, so there is no
 * light flash and no flash of the default pack.
 * Server Component–safe. Pair with `useTheme()` in client components.
 */

export const THEME_STORAGE = { mode: 'ui-theme-mode', accent: 'ui-theme-accent', pack: 'ui-theme-pack' } as const;

/** Built-in theme packs (styles/tokens/themes). `neutral` = no `data-theme` attribute. */
export type ThemePack = 'neutral' | 'stone' | 'slate' | 'soft' | 'mono';
export const THEME_PACKS: ThemePack[] = ['neutral', 'stone', 'slate', 'soft', 'mono'];

/**
 * Pack: nothing saved → leave whatever the server rendered (`<html data-theme="stone">`);
 * saved `neutral` → remove the attribute; any other saved name → set it.
 * Names are limited to [a-z0-9-] so a tampered value can't do anything odd.
 */
export const themeBootScript = `(function(){try{var d=document.documentElement,m=localStorage.getItem('${THEME_STORAGE.mode}')||'system',a=localStorage.getItem('${THEME_STORAGE.accent}'),p=localStorage.getItem('${THEME_STORAGE.pack}');if(m==='dark'||(m==='system'&&matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches))d.classList.add('dark');if(a&&a!=='neutral')d.setAttribute('data-accent',a);if(p&&/^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(p)){if(p==='neutral')d.removeAttribute('data-theme');else d.setAttribute('data-theme',p);}}catch(e){}})();`;

export interface ThemeScriptProps {
  /** CSP nonce, if your app uses one. */
  nonce?: string;
}

export function ThemeScript({ nonce }: ThemeScriptProps) {
  return <script nonce={nonce} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: themeBootScript }} />;
}
```

### `ui/theme/use-theme.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import { THEME_STORAGE, type ThemePack } from './theme-script';

export type { ThemePack } from './theme-script';
export type ThemeMode = 'light' | 'dark' | 'system';
export type ThemeAccent = 'neutral' | 'violet' | 'blue' | 'emerald' | 'rose' | 'amber' | 'orange';
export const THEME_ACCENTS: ThemeAccent[] = ['neutral', 'violet', 'blue', 'emerald', 'rose', 'amber', 'orange'];

const EVENT = 'ui:theme';
const PACK_NAME = /^[a-z0-9-]+$/;

const read = (key: string) => {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(key);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};
const write = (key: string, value: string | null) => {
  try {
    if (value === null) localStorage.removeItem(key);
    else localStorage.setItem(key, value);
  } catch {
    /* storage blocked (private mode) — the change still applies for this page */
  }
};
const systemDark = () => window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;

/** Last pack chosen in this page — keeps working when storage is blocked. */
let sessionPack: string | null = null;

function apply() {
  const root = document.documentElement;
  const mode = (read(THEME_STORAGE.mode) as ThemeMode | null) ?? 'system';
  const accent = read(THEME_STORAGE.accent);
  const pack = read(THEME_STORAGE.pack) ?? sessionPack;
  // Swap without every element transitioning its colours
  const style = document.createElement('style');
  style.textContent = '*,*::before,*::after{transition:none!important}';
  document.head.appendChild(style);
  root.classList.toggle('dark', mode === 'dark' || (mode === 'system' && systemDark()));
  if (accent && accent !== 'neutral') root.setAttribute('data-accent', accent);
  else root.removeAttribute('data-accent');
  // Nothing chosen → keep a pack the server rendered on <html>
  if (pack && PACK_NAME.test(pack)) {
    if (pack === 'neutral') root.removeAttribute('data-theme');
    else root.setAttribute('data-theme', pack);
  }
  void root.offsetHeight;
  requestAnimationFrame(() => style.remove());
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(EVENT));
}

function subscribe(cb: () => void) {
  window.addEventListener(EVENT, cb);
  window.addEventListener('storage', cb);
  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener(EVENT, cb);
    window.removeEventListener('storage', cb);
  };
}

const currentPack = () => read(THEME_STORAGE.pack) ?? sessionPack ?? document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') ?? 'neutral';
const snapshot = () =>
  `${read(THEME_STORAGE.mode) ?? 'system'}|${read(THEME_STORAGE.accent) ?? 'neutral'}|${document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? 'dark' : 'light'}|${currentPack()}`;
const serverSnapshot = () => 'system|neutral|light|neutral';

/**
 * Read and change the theme from any client component.
 *   const { mode, resolvedMode, accent, pack, setMode, setAccent, setPack, toggle } = useTheme();
 */
export function useTheme() {
  const snap = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, snapshot, serverSnapshot);
  const [mode, accent, resolvedMode, pack] = snap.split('|') as [ThemeMode, ThemeAccent, 'light' | 'dark', ThemePack];

  // Follow the OS while in system mode
  useEffect(() => {
    const mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    const onChange = () => (read(THEME_STORAGE.mode) ?? 'system') === 'system' && apply();
    mq.addEventListener('change', onChange);
    return () => mq.removeEventListener('change', onChange);
  }, []);

  const setMode = useCallback((next: ThemeMode) => {
    write(THEME_STORAGE.mode, next === 'system' ? null : next);
    apply();
  }, []);
  const setAccent = useCallback((next: ThemeAccent) => {
    write(THEME_STORAGE.accent, next === 'neutral' ? null : next);
    apply();
  }, []);
  /** Built-in pack or the name of your own `[data-theme="…"]` pack ([a-z0-9-]). */
  const setPack = useCallback((next: ThemePack | (string & {})) => {
    if (!PACK_NAME.test(next)) return;
    // `neutral` is stored explicitly: it must also override a pack the server rendered
    sessionPack = next;
    write(THEME_STORAGE.pack, next);
    apply();
  }, []);
  const toggle = useCallback(() => setMode(resolvedMode === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'), [resolvedMode, setMode]);

  return { mode, resolvedMode, accent, pack, setMode, setAccent, setPack, toggle };
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/theme-switch.css`

```css
/* Theme switch ----------------------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-theme-switch [ui-theme-switch-sm]" role="radiogroup">
     <span class="ui-theme-switch-pill">                      ONE pill, glides between options
     <button class="ui-theme-switch-item" role="radio" aria-checked>icon</button> × 3
   </div>
   useIndicator() writes --ui-tab-x/y/w/h on the group; data-ready appears after the first
   measurement and data-animate two frames later, so the first placement never animates.

   Circular reveal (View Transitions): while a reveal runs, <html data-ui-reveal> switches off
   the browser's default cross-fade; the new snapshot is clipped by a circle animated from JS.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-theme-switch {
    --ui-theme-item: 1.75rem;
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2px;
    padding: 2px;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: var(--ui-surface-muted);
  }
  .ui-theme-switch-sm { --ui-theme-item: 1.5rem; }
  /* Touch targets: 36px on coarse pointers */
  @media (pointer: coarse) {
    .ui-theme-switch { --ui-theme-item: 2.25rem; }
  }

  .ui-theme-switch-pill {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: var(--ui-tab-w, 0px);
    height: var(--ui-tab-h, 0px);
    transform: translate(var(--ui-tab-x, 0px), var(--ui-tab-y, 0px));
    border-radius: inherit;
    background-color: var(--ui-background);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-sm);
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .dark .ui-theme-switch-pill,
  [data-theme-mode="dark"] .ui-theme-switch-pill {
    background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 14%, var(--ui-surface-muted));
    box-shadow: none;
  }
  .ui-theme-switch[data-ready] .ui-theme-switch-pill { opacity: 1; }
  .ui-theme-switch[data-animate] .ui-theme-switch-pill {
    transition:
      transform var(--ui-spring-morph-duration) var(--ui-spring-morph),
      width var(--ui-spring-morph-duration) var(--ui-spring-morph),
      height var(--ui-spring-morph-duration) var(--ui-spring-morph);
  }

  .ui-theme-switch-item {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: var(--ui-theme-item);
    height: var(--ui-theme-item);
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition:
      color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  .ui-theme-switch-item[aria-checked="true"] { color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  .ui-theme-switch-item:active { transform: scale(0.92); }
  .ui-theme-switch-item:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-theme-switch-item[aria-checked="false"]:hover { color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  }
  /* Before the pill is measured (SSR / first paint) the active option carries the highlight itself */
  .ui-theme-switch:not([data-ready]) .ui-theme-switch-item[aria-checked="true"] {
    background-color: var(--ui-background);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-sm);
  }
}

/* The circular reveal: no cross-fade, the new theme is clipped by the JS-driven circle */
:root[data-ui-reveal]::view-transition-old(root),
:root[data-ui-reveal]::view-transition-new(root) {
  animation: none;
  mix-blend-mode: normal;
}
:root[data-ui-reveal]::view-transition-old(root) { z-index: 1; }
:root[data-ui-reveal]::view-transition-new(root) { z-index: 2; }

/* Reduced motion: the theme swaps instantly (JS skips the transition); the pill jumps */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .ui-theme-switch-item:active { transform: none; }
}
```

## Usage

**In a header** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/theme-switch/header.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { ThemeSwitch } from '@/ui/components/theme-switch';

export default function ThemeSwitchHeader() {
  return (
    <header className="flex w-full max-w-xl items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-border bg-card px-4 py-2.5">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-6">
        <span className="text-md font-semibold tracking-tight">Northwind</span>
        <nav aria-label="Example" className="hidden gap-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground sm:flex">
          <span>Overview</span>
          <span>Orders</span>
          <span>Customers</span>
        </nav>
      </div>
      <ThemeSwitch />
    </header>
  );
}
```
